prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Columbus after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Columbus Ohio for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
Sorry to hear you were in an accident — I can help. Before I give a short list of specific firms, a couple quick questions so I can tailor recommendations:

- Were there serious or catastrophic injuries (hospitalization, long-term disability)?  
- Do you want a large national firm or a smaller local trial firm?  
- Which part of Columbus (zip code) is most convenient?  

If you prefer, I can give a general quick list right away; otherwise I’ll tailor it based on the answers.

Immediate next steps (if you haven’t already)
- Seek/continue medical care and keep records.  
- Preserve photos, the police report number, witness contact info, vehicle damage records, and medical bills.  
- Don’t give recorded statements to insurers without a lawyer.  
- Call 3–5 lawyers to compare — most personal-injury attorneys work on contingency (no fees unless you recover).

How I’ll pick specific firms for you
- Experience handling car-accident and catastrophic-injury cases.  
- Trial experience (if your case may need litigation).  
- Good client reviews and local reputation.  
- Resources to investigate and pay for medical liens while your case is pending.  
- Contingency-fee agreement and free initial consultation.  

What to ask on the first call/consult
- Have you handled my type of case? How many similar cases? Outcome examples.  
- Will you handle my case personally or hand it to associates? Who will I contact?  
- What is your fee (percentage) and are there any costs I would pay up front?  
- Do you try cases or mainly settle?  
- Timeline and expected next steps.  

If you’d like specific firm names now, I can list several well-known personal-injury firms that serve Columbus and why you might call them — or I can produce a tailored shortlist once you tell me whether you prefer a large national firm or a local boutique and how severe the injuries were. Which would you like?
